title: add-log-level-env-var
request: Can we add support for a LANGFUSE_LOG_LEVEL env var so I can set the logger level (e.g., INFO) without using the debug flag? It should read the var and adjust the langfuse logger accordingly.
reference_diff:
--- a/langfuse/logger.py
+++ b/langfuse/logger.py
@@ -12,6 +12,7 @@
 """
 
 import logging
+import os
 
 # Create the main Langfuse logger
 langfuse_logger = logging.getLogger("langfuse")
@@ -26,3 +27,25 @@
 formatter = logging.Formatter("%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s")
 console_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
 httpx_logger.addHandler(console_handler)
+
+
+def configure_logger():
+    """Configure logger levels from environment variables.
+
+    - LANGFUSE_DEBUG: if truthy ("true", "1", "yes"), set level to DEBUG.
+    - LANGFUSE_LOG_LEVEL: explicit level name like "INFO", "WARNING", etc.
+    """
+    # Debug flag takes precedence
+    debug_val = os.getenv("LANGFUSE_DEBUG", "").lower()
+    if debug_val in ("true", "1", "yes"):
+        langfuse_logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
+        httpx_logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
+        return
+    # Explicit log level
+    level_name = os.getenv("LANGFUSE_LOG_LEVEL")
+    if level_name:
+        level = getattr(logging, level_name.upper(), None)
+        if isinstance(level, int):
+            langfuse_logger.setLevel(level)
+            httpx_logger.setLevel(level)
+
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/test_logger_log_level.py
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+import os
+import logging
+
+from langfuse.logger import langfuse_logger, configure_logger
+
+
+def test_log_level_via_env():
+    # Set env to INFO and configure logger
+    os.environ["LANGFUSE_LOG_LEVEL"] = "INFO"
+    configure_logger()
+    assert langfuse_logger.level == logging.INFO
+    # Cleanup
+    os.environ.pop("LANGFUSE_LOG_LEVEL")
+    # Reset to default warning level for other tests
+    langfuse_logger.setLevel(logging.WARNING)
